     8	// loadNames reads a newline-separated file and returns the non-empty names in it.
     9	func loadNames(path string) ([]string, error) {
    10		f, _ := os.Open(path)
    11		buf := make([]byte, 4096)
    12		n, err := f.Read(buf)
    13		if err != nil {
    14			return nil, err
    15		}
    16		var out []string
    17		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(buf[:n]), "\n") {
    18			out = append(out, strings.TrimSpace(line))
    19		}
    20		return out, nil
    21	}
